d: In this episode of Rajdoot, we examine whether Sheikh Hasina is preparing to return to Bangladesh and what her passport application reveals about her political ambitions. After applying for a new Bangladeshi passport and national identity card, Hasina has reignited political tensions in Bangladesh, where she has already been sentenced to death by the International Crimes Tribunal. We explore whether her return is genuinely possible, why the Tarique Rahman government is under pressure from both pro-Hasina supporters and opposition groups such as Jamaat-e-Islami and the National Citizen…
